event: BEI president director Jeffrey Hendrik said 300 more stocks join the high shareholding concentration (HSC) list and will be excluded from IHSG calculation, after BEI widened the screening to all listed stocks. (update of E0654)

event: MSCI is due to announce its November index review results on Thursday 12 November, with changes effective at the close of 30 November; MSCI is freezing new additions to the Indonesia IMI while deletions and downgrades can still happen. (update of E0444)

event: The rupiah closed stronger at about Rp18,062 per USD on 10 November, before news of Vice President Gibran's resignation reached the market, while analysts expect it to weaken on Wednesday. (update of E0597)
key_numbers: Rp18,062 (+23 pts, +0.13%) per Kontan/Okezone/Investor.id; Bisnis quoted Rp18,057 · 9 Nov close Rp18,070 (CNBC) · analyst range for 11 Nov Rp18,060-18,100, weekly Rp17,920-18,220, November target Rp18,500 (Ibrahim Assuaibi, Traze Andalan Futures) · record-low close Rp18,175 on 28 Oct

event: State Secretary Prasetyo Hadi announced at the Palace that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation to President Prabowo, citing developments in Constitutional Court (MK) and Supreme Court (MA) decisions. (update of E0674)
key_numbers: Announced 10 Nov ~15:22 WIB · Prabowo-Gibran meeting about 2.5 hours that morning · Prasetyo: reports that Prabowo rejected the intention are untrue · rupiah close (Rp18,062) and IHSG close (5,125.73) were set before or around the announcement, so market reaction is not yet measured

event: US October CPI rose 0.4% month on month, above the 0.3% consensus, with core up 0.3% versus 0.2% expected, and markets fully priced a 25 bp Fed hike in December. (update of E0412)
key_numbers: CPI +0.4% m/m (Sep +0.6%; Reuters poll 0.3%) · core +0.3% m/m (poll 0.2%) · Sep y/y CPI 3.7%; no Oct y/y published due to 2025 shutdown data gap · fed funds 3.75%-4.00% · Dec hike of 25 bp fully priced · DXY 102.007 on 9 Nov

event: Brent crude fell 5.85% to US$92.57 a barrel on 9 November, its lowest close since late August, after Trump said new strikes on Iran were very unlikely while talks progress. (update of E0660)
key_numbers: Brent US$92.57 (-US$5.75, -5.85%) · WTI US$86.85 (-4.38%) · Brent fell 16% the week before · Brent traded US$97.7 on 6 Nov and US$115.81 at the earlier peak

event: Bank Indonesia's retail sales survey showed September 2026 sales up 0.6% year on year but down 3.1% month on month, and BI projects October at +1% y/y.

(update of E0466)

event: Mensesneg Prasetyo Hadi said VP Gibran told President Prabowo in a roughly 2.5-hour morning meeting that he intended to resign over the MK and MA rulings; Prasetyo denied Prabowo rejected it and said Prabowo advised him to keep fighting at PTUN, while Gibran asked for a chance to prove his documents there. (update of E0466)
key_numbers: ~2.5 hour meeting (CNN) / ~2 hours (other report) · 10 Nov 2026 · Gibran did not himself state he would resign

event: DPR members from PKS (Mardani Ali Sera first signatory) and other factions began signing a Hak Menyatakan Pendapat (HMP) proposal on VP Gibran; CNN reports 50 members from six factions submitted it, while detik counted 12 signatures early that morning. (update of E0457)
key_numbers: 50 members, 6 factions (CNN, afternoon) · 12 visible signatures, 'more than 25' per Mardani (detik, 10:06 WIB)

event: Party positions on Gibran: PDIP urges him to resign or face impeachment, Golkar's Sarmuji says the DPR can use HMP, NasDem's Hermawi Taslim says resignation or replacement is fine if constitutional; DPR deputy speaker Dasco says it is still informal cross-faction talk awaiting the official MA ruling copy. (update of E0674)
key_numbers: No seat or vote thresholds stated in the sources

event: Puan Maharani opened DPR Masa Persidangan II 2026-2027 (10 Nov to 17 Dec) in a plenary without factional interruptions, setting four priority bills and 12 oversight issues including the presidential wiretapping case and karhutla. (update of E0665)

event: Jaksa KPK asked the Jakarta Tipikor panel to reject ex-Deputy Minister Silmy Karim's exception, and KPK again summoned nine private-sector witnesses in the disaster-fund (BNPB) case. (update of E0608)
key_numbers: 9 private-sector witnesses (4 attended per Tribunnews)

event: Komdigi issued three advisory letters on 9 Nov to PDN-1/Government Cloud users, government domain managers and all PSE after a BSSN security advisory on 8 Nov warned of possible attacks linked to opposition to the foreign digital transaction tax (SPP-TDLN); BSSN said the threat's authenticity is unverified.
key_numbers: 2.2 million attack attempts on Indonesia in 24h to 10 Nov 07:30 (about 26/s, highest in Southeast Asia) · about 1 million aimed at finance · 151 financial-sector incident response teams · 202 BSSN threat notices to them · 96.7% of .go.id PHP servers scanned (1,621 of 1,677) run end-of-life PHP (Vaksincom, 23 Oct)

event: Security firm ZENTARA said it handled three fund-theft cases at Indonesian financial institutions in eight weeks since August, where attackers used stolen signing keys and staff tokens rather than malware, moving money in 36 minutes to nearly seven hours.
key_numbers: 3 cases in 8 weeks (0 in prior 3 months) · 36 minutes to about 7 hours to move funds · 85% of fraud victims report after 12 hours · fraud-linked account blocking up about 53% in Aug-Sep vs Jan-Jul · 702,833 accounts blocked to 30 Sep (IASC) · one institution re-breached 8 days later · about 758,000 servers on unsupported PHP

event: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang emailed staff on 8 Nov admitting an affair with Alice Huang, a Megaspeed executive suspected by US intelligence of passing information to China; Nvidia's board opened an independent investigation and House committee chairs asked him to a closed-door meeting.
